chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 331: Ji Ning vs. the Deadliest Squad in the Brightmoon World
chapter_meta_description: The final month of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly begins! Ji Ning and Yu Wei face a super-squad with two first-place contenders—Ninefate Recluse and Blackstone Recluse. Can they survive?
og_description: Two championship contenders join forces. Ji Ning and Yu Wei are now the prey. The Immortal Fortunes Assembly just got deadly.
twitter_title: Ji Ning is about to fight two monsters at once.
twitter_description: A six-person squad with two potential first-place winners just surrounded Ji Ning and Yu Wei. The final month of the tournament is brutal.

lore_anchors.definition: The supreme realm of Fiendgod Body Refining, on par with a Daofather in Ki Refining. These beings are born from primordial chaos and are among the most powerful figures in the Three Realms.
The supreme realm of Ki Refining, equivalent to a Golden Immortal of the Great Luo. These beings master Heavenly Daos and sit at the top of the Three Realms’ power structure.
A powerful formation technique named after the mythical emperor Fuxi, who invented the Eight Trigrams. A true grandmaster of this formation can control battlefields and block top-tier experts.
A mysterious dirty girl who has comprehended five complete Daos. Xiamang Qi considers her unbeatable; she is a potential first-place contender in the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.
A barefoot, dark-skinned youth and a formation grandmaster. His Fuxi Staff Formation once scared off Xiamang Zishan and Cangwu Jiu, making him a top threat in the tournament.
The pocket world used for the final trial of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly, where candidates hunt each other for talismans.
